'''Wren Cristol''' worked as a spotter for the [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]] [[Lev Palik]] and together, they formed [[recon team 05]]. During a conflict on a world, recon team 05 were ordered to take up a position near to an enemy bunker. When a group of allied agents were sent to attack the bunker, they rendezvoused with Palik and Cristol, to learn more about it.<ref name="Galaxy at War" />
